'''Ryle Torsyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|campaign]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Gold Three/Legends|Gold Three]], Torsyn [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
Recruited into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], Ryle Torsyn was stationed at the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where he served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] led by veteran [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]]. While there, Torsyn discovered a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]], forcing the base's evacuation, which he led, flying a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]].<ref name="CCGRT" /><ref name="CCGG3">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 3}}</ref>

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Torsyn had been transferred to the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and was a member of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] under the command of [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]]. Flying a Y-wing as [[Gold Three/Legends|Gold Three]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the attack on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], along with most of his squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" /><ref name="Episode IV" /><ref name="CCGRT" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Torsyn was an unnamed character in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]<ref name="Episode IV" /> until the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] gave him a name and [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]].<ref name="CCGRT" /> According to the website Aveleyman, He was portrayed by [[John Ketteringham]],<ref name="Aveleyman">
{{WebCite|url=http://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=79605|text=Aveleyman - John Ketteringham|archivedate=20181104145404}}</ref> an actor listed as a Death Star Controller during the film's production.<ref name="OverbridgeBTS">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2016/04/behind-scenes-inside-death-star.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=BEHIND THE SCENES: INSIDE THE DEATH STAR OVERBRIDGE}}</ref>

Gold Three would later be identified in canon as [[Evaan Verlaine]], who replaced both Torsyn and [[Keyan Farlander]]. Unlike Torsyn, Verlaine survived the Battle of Yavin. Torsyn is later confirmed in canon to also have participated and perished as a Gold Squadron member during the Battle of Yavin, though his new callsign has not been identified.
